recommendations.title: Take a quiet pause
recommendations.action: At the next safe, agreed pause, give yourself a few quiet minutes before another optional task.
recommendations.reason: A small recovery step for the next safe agreed pause or after operations.

recommendations.title: Talk through the demanding moment
recommendations.action: Share one thing that took effort and one thing that helped with your crewmate or ground support.
recommendations.reason: A short debrief can help share the effort of a demanding sequence.

recommendations.title: Protect your next rest opportunity
recommendations.action: After operations, keep the agreed rest time clear and check in with yourself about how you feel.
recommendations.reason: A small recovery step for the next safe agreed pause or after operations.

loadBandSource: Example rule: demanding if demand >20 and pressure >=2; moderate if demand >20, effort >2, coordination >1 or pressure >1; otherwise light. All baseline ranges are simulated; not clinical thresholds.
